home.welcome_message: Welcome to EcoLab! To get started, select the species you want to include in your analysis. You can use the search bar to find species by name or explore the taxonomic tree to discover new related species. As you select species, they will appear in the list on the side, and you can review or remove your choices at any time. When you're satisfied with your selection, click 'Next' to proceed to the filters step and further customize your query. Let's start exploring biodiversity together!
